html:
Hello to all my readers and fans. It has been a very busy summer as I finished and put the polishing touches on The Time Seer, the fifth book in my Endarian Prophecy epic fantasy series. I spent most of that time in our historic mountain ranch retreat in the high country of New Mexico. The house I grew up in was built by Sheriff William Brady who was killed by Billy the Kid a short distance from there.

Here’s a little drone and walk through video to give you a taste of the property we call Walnut Grove Ranch and which we have kept in the family and is now an Airbnb and VRBO

Enjoy…
